system.description: You carry an ongoing rivalry with someone — another Toreador, another Cainite, even a mortal. You may not even remember how it started, but you and your rival are now inseparable in each other's minds, and he takes every opportunity to slander you and advance himself at your expense. A one-dot rival is at your own power level and mostly just annoying; a two-dot rival occasionally takes harmful action against you or wields some real influence; a three-dot rival has no qualms about attempting to seriously harm your interests, reputation, or unlife. Ending or cooling the rivalry, if it can be done at all, takes a very long time.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book One: Artisans (Toreador)
